issues.description: References 'assess-python-data-processing-001' which is explicitly marked as a summative assessment.
References 'assess-python-data-processing-002' which is explicitly marked as a summative assessment.

technical_review.notes: Summative assessments are improperly nested into lesson formative assessment arrays[cite: 18].

special_question.answer: Marginally reasonable, but constrained heavily by time.
special_question.notes: The total task time requested in the summative assessments (30-45 minutes total) leaves only 15-30 minutes for instruction, making the 60-minute overall budget severely compressed[cite: 18].

rubric_scores.rationale: Clear success criteria covering both code implementation and written justification[cite: 18].
The hands-on task and written justification directly reflect the procedural and conceptual capabilities[cite: 18].
The tasks yield highly valid evidence of data transformation skills[cite: 18].
Aligned well with apply and evaluate cognitive levels[cite: 18].
Prerequisites correctly state that basic Python and dataset loading are strictly required[cite: 18].
Transforming data before evaluating and justifying choices is a standard and effective pedagogical sequence[cite: 18].
Because the summative assessments are improperly used as formative practice within the lessons, there is a risk of teaching directly to the test[cite: 18].
Dedicating only short 8-10 minute bursts to teach complex library implementation before a rigorous coding exam will likely result in under-prepared learners[cite: 18].
Content stays tightly scoped to missing and invalid data handling[cite: 18].
Requires extraction of summative tasks from lesson structures and adjusting time limits to create room for realistic instruction.

prerequisite_acceptance.notes: These prerequisites represent the necessary entry foundation for the course[cite: 18].

edit_effort.notes: Remove the summative assessment IDs from the formative assessment arrays in lessons 003 and 006, and rebalance the time budget.

pedagogical_review.overall_notes: A well-intended design that suffers from trying to fit highly rigorous, time-consuming summative assessments into an impossibly short total time constraint[cite: 18].
